title: P2-M ‘smuggled’ cigarettes in ice boxes seized in Lanao Norte

blocks.text: CAGAYAN DE ORO CITY — Authorities intercepted over P2 million worth of suspected smuggled cigarettes cleverly concealed inside fish ice boxes during a checkpoint operation in Kolambugan, Lanao del Norte. Joint police and military operatives seized the contraband from an Isuzu Elf truck that was flagged down at a checkpoint in Barangay Libertad at 6:40
